claims.statement: The feature-availability fragment compares data-resident enterprise features with managed-user enterprises on GitHub while expressly retaining additions and exceptions. Similarity is not feature parity, verified entitlement, or authority to reuse github.com assumptions on another host.

The API fragment requires REST and GraphQL integrations to target the data-resident enterprise's dedicated URL. It supplies no actual enterprise host, token, endpoint path, granted scope, or successful request; no integration or credentials were changed.

The network fragment requires client trust of GitHub SSH fingerprints and access to specified hostnames/IPs through a linked network reference. It supplies no fingerprint/address values here; neither link existence nor trust advice validates a host key, authorizes expanding network trust, or proves connectivity. The destination was not reviewed.

The dependency-data fragment says organization dependency insights and graph license/package metadata are unavailable on the data-residency site at this pin while the repository graph remains available. Repository graph presence is therefore not metadata availability or rights clearance, and these historical limits are not a current tested API observation.

The Marketplace limitation exists only in the ghec branch and states Marketplace apps are unavailable on the data-residency site at the pin. Outside that branch it renders no claim. This is not universal app incompatibility, a current feature matrix, or authorization to install an alternative.

The adoption fragment describes storage-location choice and a dedicated enterprise subdomain, claims separation of open-source/enterprise work and help with residency requirements, and lists EU (including EFTA Azure regions in Norway/Switzerland), Australia, US, and Japan, with future expansion intent. These historical region/product claims are not a compliance determination, contractual data-boundary guarantee, current region list, or committed delivery promise; no migration or purchase occurred.
